blocks.prompt: Link to your slides, shared so anyone at Bosco Tech can open it

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Your before photo, where it is in the IDEA building, and who the problem slows down.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One of the three is missing.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A photo or a sentence that does not make the problem clear.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No slide.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Both sketches, and one line on why you picked the one you built.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Both sketches, but no reason for the pick.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only one design shown.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No slide.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Photos of both major parts being made, each machine named, and one problem you hit and how you solved it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Photos and machines, but no problem, or machines not named.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Photos with nothing said about them.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No slide.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Your critical dimension: designed size and tolerance, your locked prediction, what you measured, inside or outside the tolerance, and why it came out there, matching your Build Log fit check.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The numbers and the verdict, with a reason that is vague or does not match your fit check.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Numbers with no verdict or reason.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No slide, or no numbers.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The fix installed in the spot from slide 1, doing its job.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Installed but not shown working, or shown somewhere other than the problem spot.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No slide.

criteria.text: Delivery: about 4 minutes, to the room

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Talks to the room rather than reading the slides, and lands near 4 minutes.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One slip: reads most of the slides, or runs well over or under.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Both slips.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Did not present.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Answers two questions from the class or the teacher with specifics about your own part.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Answers, but vaguely or without reference to the part.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Does not answer.
